title: Plant Manager
text:
Description:

**MAC Medical** is known for having a team culture that works together and inspires us to be better! We are a family owned and operated business founded in 1998 which builds American made medical equipment.

**JOB SUMMARY**

The Plant Manager is responsible for overseeing all daily manufacturing operations within the facility, including production, fabrication, welding, polishing, assembly, material handling, scheduling, and shipping.

This position provides strategic and operational leadership to ensure production goals are achieved, customer requirements are met, resources are effectively utilized, employees are properly trained, and manufacturing processes operate safely and efficiently.

The Plant Manager is responsible for establishing a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, employee development, operational discipline, and cross-departmental collaboration while supporting the company's business objectives, quality standards, and customer commitments.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

* Oversee all daily manufacturing operations, including stainless steel fabrication, welding, polishing, assembly, material handling, and shipping.
* Manage production schedules, staffing, workflow, and resources to meet customer demands and delivery commitments.
* Lead, develop, and hold supervisors, team leaders, and manufacturing personnel accountable for performance and operational goals.
* Monitor production efficiency, labor utilization, quality, scrap, rework, downtime, and operational costs.
* Identify operational challenges and implement process improvements to increase productivity, reduce waste, and improve efficiency.
* Ensure products meet established specifications, quality standards, customer requirements, and applicable ISO procedures.
* Promote a safe working environment and ensure compliance with OSHA regulations, company safety policies, and PPE requirements.
* Coordinate with Engineering, Quality, Purchasing, Maintenance, Warehouse, and Human Resources to support manufacturing operations.
* Oversee equipment maintenance, inventory availability, and production resources to minimize disruptions and downtime.
* Support employee training, performance management, coaching, corrective action, and workforce development.
* Implement lean manufacturing, 5S, continuous improvement, and operational accountability initiatives.
* Communicate production performance, operational challenges, and improvement opportunities to executive leadership.
* Perform additional duties and responsibilities as assigned.

**REQUIRED SKILLS AND KNOWLEDGE**

* Strong knowledge of stainless-steel fabrication and manufacturing processes, including welding, polishing, forming, cutting, and assembly.
* Ability to read and interpret blueprints, manufacturing drawings, specifications, and work instructions.
* Knowledge of production scheduling, workflow management, quality systems, inventory control, and manufacturing operations.
* Understanding of ISO standards, safety regulations, lean manufacturing, and continuous improvement principles.
* Strong leadership, communication, problem-solving, decision-making, and employee development skills.
* Ability to establish expectations, manage performance, and hold employees accountable.
* Ability to analyze production data, identify inefficiencies, and implement improvements.
* Proficiency with manufacturing systems, ERP software, and Microsoft Office.

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITY**

This position has direct supervisory responsibility for manufacturing personnel.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT**

This position operates primarily within a stainless-steel manufacturing facility and is regularly exposed to manufacturing equipment, machinery, welding operations, metal fabrication processes, polishing operations, noise, heat, dust, airborne particles, moving equipment, and industrial traffic. Proper personal protective equipment (PPE) and adherence to all company safety policies and procedures are required.

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS**

* Ability to stand and walk throughout the manufacturing facility for extended periods.
* Ability to navigate manufacturing floors, production areas, warehouse areas, and workstations.
* Ability to bend, stoop, reach, climb stairs, and perform occasional physical tasks as necessary.
* Ability to lift up to 50 pounds occasionally, if required.
* Ability to work on concrete surfaces for extended periods.
* Ability to maintain awareness of machinery, forklifts, equipment, welding operations, and other workplace hazards.
* Ability to wear required PPE.
* Must maintain safe work practices and ensure compliance with applicable safety requirements.

**POSITION TYPE / EXPECTED HOURS OF WORK**

This is a full-time exempt position. The Plant Manager is expected to maintain a schedule necessary to effectively oversee manufacturing operations and support business needs. Standard work hours may vary based on production schedules, staffing, operational demands, and management requirements. Occasional evening, weekend, or extended hours may be required.

**BENEFITS**

Health insurance

Dental insurance

Vision insurance

Life insurance

Short-term disability

Long-term disability

Paid time off

Paid holidays

Employee assistance program

401(k)

401(k) matching
